description.value: Nature's Essence is a health food and natural products shop located inside a Richmond shopping centre, stocking a broad range of vitamins, supplements, and wellness brands alongside a modest food section (honey, proteins, teas, maple products). The store carries hundreds of brands spanning organic, vegan, and whole-food lines, making it a useful stop for cyclists seeking sports nutrition, electrolyte products, or natural snacks. It also offers beauty and body care, essential oils, and cleaning products.
